# Windsurf & Cascade Agentic Flow Orchestration

Orchestrate autonomous coding agents with Cascade inside the Windsurf AI environment.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Specify project constraints and architecture rules in `.windsurfrules` at repository root.
- Monitor Cascade's autonomous task list and interrupt execution if divergence occurs.
- Verify shell commands and sandbox filesystem changes before granting execution approval.
- Demand RED-GREEN-REFACTOR TDD discipline for all agentic code contributions.
